english.title: Molest / let / disturb /vex / trouble a preacher / clergy ministering / celebrating a sacrament / Divine service / rite
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[molested, let, disturbed, vexed or troubled]_
(B)_[by unlawful means disquieted or misused]_

**(..SPECIFY PREACHER OR CLERGYMAN..), a

(C)_[preacher duly authorised to preach in a cathedral, parish or district church or chapel of the Church of England or other religious denomination or in England in a place of religious worship duly certified under the Places of Worship Registration Act 1855]_
(D)_[clergyman in Holy Orders ministering or celebrating a sacrament]
(E)_[clergyman in Holy Orders ministering or celebrating a Divine service, rite or office]_

in a

(F)_[cathedral church or chapel]_
(G)_[churchyard]_
(H)_[burial ground]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2 of the Ecclesiastical Courts Jurisdiction Act 1860.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
